Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 16
Reason for Mistake: After authoritative PDFs of Freud’s 1928 “Dostoevsky and Parricide” were identified (Step 14), WebSurfer opened the PDF but failed to extract, scroll, or text-search within the document to retrieve the needed quote. Returning an empty viewport without attempting an in-document search (e.g., for “Oedipus,” “Tyrannus,” or “greatest works”) stalled progress and forced the loop to continue, directly preventing recovery of the exact wording needed to fill the blank.
